summary: 73-year-old Ken Teselle of Estes Park, an off-duty park volunteer, took a tumbling fall while descending Mount Lady Washington above Chasm Lake; bystanders witnessed the fall and performed CPR, and park rangers from the nearby Chasm Shelter area reached him within 15 minutes and also performed CPR; pronounced dead at the scene; body recovery began the next day due to location and poor weather
location: Mount Lady Washington above Chasm Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: User-supplied lead 2026-09-14 (CBS Colorado story). NPS release dated 2017-08-23.
